description: This Java class 'AttributeIncentiveCalculationFactory' provides a factory method to obtain instances of 'AttributeIncentiveCalculation' based on 'InterestIncentiveEntityType'. It uses a switch statement to determine the specific calculation to create, currently only handling the 'CUSTOMER' case.

classes.name: AttributeIncentiveCalculationFactory
classes.description: A utility class implementing a factory pattern to generate 'AttributeIncentiveCalculation' instances based on entity type.

methods.name: findAttributeIncentiveCalculation
methods.description: Returns an 'AttributeIncentiveCalculation' instance appropriate for the given 'InterestIncentiveEntityType'.
